name: Ultimate Spidermonkey
abilities: Web spitting from a splitting lower jaw (far more webbing than Spidermonkey)
Web ensnarement, web nets and web cushions
Two pairs of retractable, sharp spider legs from the waist (UA design)
Enhanced durability, radiation and heat resistance (survived atmospheric re-entry)
Enhanced jumping, agility and wall scaling; prehensile feet
weaknesses: Webs can be torn by Anodites or dissolved by Atomix's nuclear energy
Put to sleep by Argit's sedative quills
Ears vulnerable to Ultimate Sonorosian sonics
Loses Spidermonkey's small size and tail-based agility
summary: The evolved Arachnachimp: a hulking purple gorilla with six eyes and four retractable spider legs who spits heavy webbing from a splitting jaw. Trades Spidermonkey's nimbleness for raw muscle.
traits: First Ultimate form used in Ultimate Alien
Six eyes, jaw splits to spit webs
Voiced by Dee Bradley Baker (UA), Paul Eiding (OV)
notableFeats: Defeated Sir Driscoll, spider legs piercing concrete (The Purge)
Defeated Mizaru (Simian Says) and Hugh (Double or Nothing)
Fell from space through the atmosphere completely unharmed after fighting the Vreedles (The Mother of All Vreedles)
As Albedo: overpowered Four Arms and survived Atomix's Nuclear Winner (The Ultimate Heist; For a Few Brains More)

appearances.designNotes: Large gorilla-like body with purple skin and black fur, three pairs of green eyes, no tail or extra arms; two pairs of long purple spider legs that fold into the waist; lower jaw splits to shoot webs; green evolved Ultimatrix symbol on chest. (Albedo's OV redesign instead has six gorilla arms, yellow fangs and the symbol on the stomach.)

image.label: UA
image.notes: Infobox render labelled UA; verified green symbol, spider legs extended. Retracted-legs alternative: 'Ult Spidermonkey legs retracted.png'.

scoring.rationale: Strong enough to overpower Four Arms, tough enough to survive re-entry and Atomix's Nuclear Winner, and his webbing holds Vaxasaurians - a solid step above Spidermonkey. Little ranged threat beyond webs, which Anodites tear and nuclear energy dissolves, and Argit's quills put him to sleep.

notes: OMNIVERSE: only Albedo used Ultimate Spidermonkey (The Ultimate Heist, A Fistful of Brains, For a Few Brains More, And Then There Were None, Malgax Attacks) - complete redesign with eight limbs. No Ben used it in OV, so no OV appearance; infobox OV image 'Negative ultimate spidermonkey official.png' is Albedo's.
'Double or Nothing' has two uses; the second reverted when passing through a force field.
Dream appearance in 'Night of the Living Nightmare' (defeated by Vilgax) not counted.
Retractable/sharp spider legs are a UA-only feature; DJW said Ben's OV version would also have six arms.

Sentient Ultimates storyline (UA S3, 'The Ultimate Sacrifice'): the six most-used Ultimate forms (Humungousaur, Swampfire, Spidermonkey, Big Chill, Cannonbolt, Echo Echo) gained sentience inside the Ultimatrix and demanded freedom; Ben offered his life, Azmuth freed them to their own world and reworked the Ultimatrix so Ultimates are 'empty shells' again.

Ultimate forms are artificial by-products of the Ultimatrix's evolutionary function (added by Albedo): the DNA is run through a simulated worst-case scenario over millions of theoretical years to force combat-oriented evolution. They are not natural Codon Stream species, and the Omniverse Omnitrix has no evolutionary function, so Ben never regains them after UA (Derrick J. Wyatt).
